The tour covered the pumping stations in the towns of Batoulay, Seddiqine and Ras al-Ain.

caveats: Self-published. Every line is the utility's own claim about its own work, with no independent check and no photograph or contract behind it here.

Undated. The export carried no date field, so no post can be placed against the 31 July 2026 cut-off, and the file's own summary states it cannot be confirmed that all of them fall after 2 March 2026.
Individual posts are not linkable. The export carried no post URLs, so every row cites the establishment's official page rather than the single post it came from.
Three posts appeared twice in the source and the second copy of each was removed, leaving 603 of the 606 supplied.
Department labels are the utility's own. The match from a post to a cadastral town is ours, made on place-name matching, and is approximate.
A repair is not reconstruction. Restoring supply to a line says nothing about whether the houses on it are standing or the people are back.
